component.name: MGAcid
component.summary: Native port of Metal Gear Ac!d

description.p: MGAcid is a native port of Metal Gear Ac!d made by static recompilation: the game's PSP code is translated ahead of time into native code and runs on a reimplementation of the PSP system software, with Vulkan graphics, gamepad support and PSP-compatible saves.
It can also play your own recordings in place of the game's music, and draw replacement textures from a folder of your own, enlarged by the engine where the game builds its interface art as it runs.

MGAcid does not include any game assets or original game files: no disc image, no copy of the game's executable or data, and no textures, models, audio or video from the game. You must provide the files from your own legally obtained copy of Metal Gear Ac!d (ULUS-10006): the first start checks that copy, accepts only the original release, and sets the game up from it.
MGAcid is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Konami or Sony.
